name: Bicycle/Sewing Machine Assistance Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
benefit: Bicycles are provided to construction workers in the plain areas, while sewing machines are provided to construction workers or their dependents in the hilly areas.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, or a dependent of such a worker.
